patient_documents_filename_safe.name: patient_documents_filename_safe
patient_documents_filename_safe.value: length("patient_documents"."filename") > 0 AND position('/' in "patient_documents"."filename") = 0 AND position(chr(92) in "patient_documents"."filename") = 0 AND "patient_documents"."filename" NOT IN ('.', '..')

reminders_sent_metadata_consistent.name: reminders_sent_metadata_consistent
reminders_sent_metadata_consistent.value: ("reminders"."status" = 'staff_confirmed_sent' AND "reminders"."sent_by_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reminders"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("reminders"."status" <> 'staff_confirmed_sent' AND "reminders"."sent_by_staff_id" IS NULL AND "reminders"."sent_at" IS NULL)

aligner_trays_dates_ordered.name: aligner_trays_dates_ordered
aligner_trays_dates_ordered.value: "aligner_trays"."planned_date" IS NULL OR "aligner_trays"."delivered_date" IS NULL OR "aligner_trays"."delivered_date" >= "aligner_trays"."planned_date"

prescription_amendments_replacement_vali.name: prescription_amendments_replacement_valid
prescription_amendments_replacement_vali.value:
(
    ("prescription_amendments"."amendment_type" = 'correction' AND "prescription_amendments"."replacement" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("prescription_amendments"."amendment_type" = 'void' AND "prescription_amendments"."replacement" IS NULL)
  )

marketing_campaigns_dates_ordered.name: marketing_campaigns_dates_ordered
marketing_campaigns_dates_ordered.value: "marketing_campaigns"."start_date" is null or "marketing_campaigns"."end_date" is null or "marketing_campaigns"."start_date" <= "marketing_campaigns"."end_date"
